n2b2b4ed93f.headline: Santa Lucía, fully operational in 2069
n2b2b4ed93f.summary: The Mexican government announced that construction of the Santa Lucía airport will begin in June with a budget of 68,367 million pesos plus VAT, aiming for operations to start in 2021.
n2b2b4ed93f.why: Large infrastructure projects like airports can stimulate economic growth, create jobs, and improve logistics and connectivity.
